title: CheckResponse
description: One verdict for each check that was asked for.

verdicts.description: One verdict per check, in the order describe lists the checks.

verdict.description: What one check found: passed, failed, or inconclusive when the checkout is not set up for it, it could not be run to its end or ended in a way the toolchain does not recognise.

passed.description: The check ran to its end and found nothing.

failed.description: The check ran to its end and found something wrong.

verdict.description: The check found something wrong; its output says what.

inconclusive.description: The checkout is not set up for the check, or the check could not be started, did not finish in time, or ended in a way the toolchain does not recognise, so nothing is known.

verdict.description: Nothing is known; never read it as passed.

reason.description: One sentence saying why nothing is known.

name.description: The check's name, as describe lists it.

seconds.description: How long the check took, in seconds.

stdout.description: The end of what the check wrote to its standard output, with known secrets removed.

stderr.description: The end of what the check wrote to its standard error, with known secrets removed.
